name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Growth Workflow Specialist role. This one sits exactly where I already work: technical SEO on one side, AI agents and workflow automation on the other. Taking what a strategist knows and making it run at scale through automation is the core of what I do every day.

Here is how that maps to your engine. I run technical SEO audits, keyword and competitor gap analysis, and CMS fixes, and I build the LLM-driven agents that turn that signal into content, then QA the output for accuracy and brand fit before it ships. I think in systems, I map a workflow as triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements, and I write the specs precisely enough for a build team to implement without guessing. I've shipped 20+ end-to-end automations that run continuously, and I design the evaluation loops that keep agent output reliable, which is exactly the QA and knowledge-base work this role calls for.

AEO is new ground for everyone, and that's the part I find most interesting. Optimizing for an intelligence rather than a crawler is a systems and prompting problem, and building the monitoring and response workflows around LLM visibility is squarely the kind of thing I like to build. I'd welcome the conversation.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
